title: Broken rendering of shadows in 4.8.dev on macOS on Intel when from Mobile and Forward+
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible from: v4.8.dev4.official [b56a91878], v4.8.dev5.official [9552dfb68], v4.8.dev6.official [8898c2b3d], v4.8.dev7.official [c971f93e7]. - Not reproducible in: v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4]. ### System information Godot v4.8.dev7 - macOS Ventura (13.7.8) - Multi-window, 1 monitor (3360x2100 @ 0.00 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(TM) Plus Graphics 640 - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-7360U CPU @ 2.30GHz (4 threads) - 8.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description On macOS on Intel, Godot v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4] is generally the most stable version of the editor when it comes to low-end Intel iGPUs (for now). An [update](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-build-scripts/pull/173) to the last [Vulkan SDK release](https://vulkan.lunarg.com/sdk/home#mac) has recently fixed an [issue that blocked usage of the Godot editor for some](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/120897). Unfortunately, I suspect that it may have also introduced some new bugs. When creating a new project from the Mobile and Forward+ renderers, shadows appear momentarily sound—before devolving into mangled messes upon camera movement in the viewport. The Compatibility renderer, somewhat predictably, appears unaffected. In the examples below I have imported Passivestar's interior and exterior scenes from their [blogpost on lightmaps](https://passivestar.xyz/posts/how-to-light-scenes/) to clearly show what's going wrong. *** As mentioned above: When opening the editor for the first time, and upon subsequent launches after a clean quit, shadows appear relatively coherent. It is only upon camera movement in the viewport do the shadows appear to break down. *** A short [clip](https://youtu.be/NR2OYfUT81E) of this shadow schizophrenia as I fly around the scene. Sorry I wasn't able to upload this directly. *** Comparison between the same scene rendered in Compatibility versus Forward+. ### Steps to reproduce Try creating a new project in any one release of Godot 4.8.dev from v4.8.dev4.official [b56a91878] and onwards, either with the Mobile or Forward+ renderers, on an Mac with an intel CPU and integrated graphics. Create a MeshInstance3D directly in the editor or import a 3D model yourself; observe the shadows falling apart. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) This issue is prevalent on all releases of Godot 4.8dev starting from v4.8.dev4.official [b56a91878] and onwards.
